rule.population: packages/zod/src/v4/**/*.ts excluding **/tests/**, **/locales/**, *.d.ts; exported class declarations (a) and exported `const X = [/*@__PURE__*/] [core.]$constructor(...)` (b)
rule.related_types: top-level interface / type alias in the same file whose name is X or starts with X + one of ["Def","Internals","Params","Config","Issue","Fn"]
rule.leading_comment: comment ranges immediately preceding an included statement with no blank line in between
rule.source_text: included statements in file order, verbatim, joined by one blank line; no imports, nothing else
rule.ordering: files sorted by path (classic < core < mini), then by statement position; unit_id = 3-digit 1-based index + class_name
rule.path_mapping: none ($ kept in unit_id and file names)
